intro: The Empty Leaden Collection Phial is a shielded container designed by gnome tinkerers to harvest radioactive fallout from the ruins of Gnomeregan. Crafted from lead to protect the bearer from lethal contamination, it is used by adventurers assisting Ozzie Togglevolt in Kharanos. Ozzie hopes the captured glow might yield a cure for their afflicted kin—or at least an extraordinarily potent beverage.

p: When the vents of Gnomeregan flooded the subterranean city with toxic radiation to purge the trogg menace, it instead warped the surviving defenders into leper gnomes and irradiated the invading beasts. Seeking to study and reverse the fallout, Ozzie Togglevolt crafted the Empty Leaden Collection Phial. Made of heavy lead to shield handlers from the ambient danger, the specialized vial draws in the noxious green glow lingering on the bodies of Irradiated Invaders and Pillagers that prowl the ruins. Once sealed, the resulting Full Leaden Collection Phial provides the raw, dangerous matter needed for experimental remedies.
